sources.title: GitHub - iNavLabsResearch/kupe-thinkspark: Thinking Sound and Words Model
sources.snippet: Voice AI agents run STT → LLM → TTS. Between the user finishing (STT) and the agent's real reply (TTS) there is dead air. ThinkSpark fills that gap with a human thinking sound / backchannel — hmm, अच्छा, एक सेकंड, sí sí, ええと — in the right language, native script, register and emotion for the moment.
